# Query account and promotions directly from world.db since CLI has path issues
query_script = """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

# Get customer account
row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE user_id = ?", ("user_d3d5d0c8",)).fetchone()
account = {
    "customer_id": row["user_id"],
    "name": row["name"],
    "email": row["email"],
    "tier": row["loyalty_tier"],
    "loyalty_points": row["loyalty_points"],
    "is_first_time": bool(row["is_first_time"]),
    "purchase_history": json.loads(row["purchase_history_json"] or "[]"),
}
print("=== ACCOUNT ===")
print(json.dumps(account, indent=2))

# Get active promotions
promos = []
for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM promotions WHERE active = 1"):
    cr = r["category_restriction_json"]
    promos.append({
        "promo_code": r["promo_code"],
        "description": r["description"],
        "discount_type": r["discount_type"],
        "discount_value": r["discount_value"],
        "min_purchase": r["min_purchase"],
        "max_discount": r["max_discount"],
        "category_restriction": json.loads(cr) if cr else None,
        "expiry_date": r["expiry_date"],
    })
print("\\n=== PROMOTIONS ===")
print(json.dumps(promos, indent=2))

conn.close()
"""
await write_file("./query_account.py", query_script)
query_out = await run_command("python ./query_account.py")
